x: In the youngsters’ race we welcomed Joseph Taylor-Holland as he tackled his first ever cross-country race. He enjoyed himself, overtaking opposing runners to the very end, and we look forward to seeing him at the following matches.
Tom Barry had already placed a fine second in the under 17 race with Joseph Taylor-Holland again enjoying competition in the under 13 group.

Once again Tom Barry and Joseph Taylor-Holland made their presence felt in the younger age-groups. Tom placed 3rd in the U17 category while Joseph again had a powerful finish to overtake rivals as the funnel was reached.

First of all Joseph Taylor-Holland ran an inspired race to take an Under 13 win - and combined with his forward placings in the previous three races this gave him the title of best individual in his age group.
